parsed.scene_description: The image shows the interior of a small shop or convenience store with glass doors leading outside. Shelves stocked with beverages and packaged goods line the right side. A poster with Chinese characters hangs above the entrance. Outside, palm trees and a bench are visible under bright daylight.

objects.label: glass doors
objects.observation: Double glass doors with metal handles are centered in the frame. They lead to an outdoor area with palm trees and a bench. The doors have a green 'EXIT' sign above them. Bright sunlight illuminates the exterior view.

objects.label: shelves with products
objects.observation: Shelves on the right side hold various packaged goods, including milk cartons and jars. The items are arranged neatly on multiple levels. The shelves appear to be part of a refrigerated unit with glass panels.

objects.label: poster
objects.observation: A blue poster with Chinese characters and images is mounted above the glass doors. It features graphics of people and text that reads '看我多热爱'. The poster is affixed to the wall directly above the entrance.

objects.label: outdoor bench
objects.observation: A wooden bench is visible through the glass doors, positioned outdoors on a paved surface. Palm trees are behind it, suggesting a tropical or subtropical setting. The bench is partially obscured by glare from sunlight.

objects.label: table with items
objects.observation: A small table on the left holds various items, including a bottle, a bag, and what appears to be a magazine or booklet. The table is near the entrance and partially obstructs the view of the outdoor area.
